title: journal
description: Read the repo's turn journal: append-only facts about the fleet (worker-created, task-dispatched, turn-started/completed, worker-replaced), newest last. History - the inbox stays the mailbox for messages that need reading; the journal is what happened, for supervision and debugging.

tail.description: only the last N records (default 20; 0 = all)

slot.description: only records about this slot label
